agency: Department of Housing and Urban Development
summary: HUD acknowledges familiarity with the TARGET/Pratt and Whitney fuel cell program, noting that staff attended the Farmington dedication and met with the project manager, but states that Pratt and Whitney has not recommended using the fuel cell at this stage of development and HUD staff concurs, though HUD expresses willingness to demonstrate the technology at the appropriate time.
